title: Agent Smith work spec
description: p0390: the versioned statement of WHAT must be true for one ticket. It carries requirements, constraints and done-criteria — never steps and never target files, which belong to the plan.

key.description: <provider>-<ticketId>: the path segment and the database key.

goal.description: One sentence: what this work delivers.

requirements.description: What must be true when the work is done. No steps, no file names.

constraints.description: Technical rules carried VERBATIM out of the ticket. One rule, one home: the rule is here, its sample is in spec.md under sample_anchor.

sample_anchor.description: Anchor of the heading in spec.md that carries this rule's sample.

done.description: The ONE criteria list. While a ratified expectation exists these are its assertions verbatim and the list is read-only.

done_is_read_only.description: True while the criteria are the ratified expectation's — revise_work_spec rejects edits to them.

assumptions.description: Unresolved points are RECORDED here, not parked on.

revisions.description: Append-only revision headers. Re-entry amends, never regenerates.

handback_case.description: Enumerable hand-back case. NotImplementable is a verdict, not a question.
